claim: Flare is the mood signature authors reach for constantly, and under floodlights it is nearly free. Starburst says hard and clean, warm_bloom says nostalgic, veiling says the light is in your eyes and you cannot see properly.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: anamorphic lens flare, horizontal blue streak
warm bloom, glowing haze, soft glow
starburst, sun star, pointed light rays
veiling glare, washed out haze, lifted blacks

look_at: starburst and warm_bloom read; anamorphic_streak never streaks.
